items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: Do you remember Bobby? ... He was a good drummer. Yeah. He went out there to California too. You there yet? That's another, no, I heard from him.

ctx.x: Yeah. Did you ever know that fella called Robert Henry used to run the booster discussion?
Robert Henry. Robert Henry. Memphis. From Memphis. I made more money than I had to make more money one night. You told me about that. That's right. Do you remember Bobby?
Huh? Do you remember Bobby? Oh sure. Used to call him Hard Yard. Yeah.
